title: Kalshi Active Markets
description: Fetches all active prediction markets from Kalshi, the only CFTC-regulated prediction exchange in the U.S. Captures current yes/no prices, bid-ask spreads, 24h volume, open interest, and market category. Kalshi covers weather events, economic indicators, Fed rate decisions, elections, and more. As a regulated exchange, its prices reflect institutional-grade market sentiment.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2'
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

rows = []
cursor = None

for page in range(5):
    params = {'limit': 200, 'status': 'active'}
    if cursor:
        params['cursor'] = cursor

    resp = requests.get(f'{BASE}/markets', params=params, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    markets = data.get('markets', [])
    if not markets:
        break

    for m in markets:
        yes_bid = float(m.get('yes_bid', 0) or 0) / 100.0
        yes_ask = float(m.get('yes_ask', 0) or 0) / 100.0
        no_bid = float(m.get('no_bid', 0) or 0) / 100.0
        no_ask = float(m.get('no_ask', 0) or 0) / 100.0
        last_price = float(m.get('last_price', 0) or 0) / 100.0
        prev_price = float(m.get('previous_price', 0) or 0) / 100.0
        volume = int(m.get('volume', 0) or 0)
        volume_24h = int(m.get('volume_24h', 0) or 0)
        open_interest = int(m.get('open_interest', 0) or 0)

        spread = round(yes_ask - yes_bid, 4) if yes_ask > 0 and yes_bid > 0 else 0.0
        price_change = round(last_price - prev_price, 4)

        rows.append({
            'ticker': m.get('ticker', ''),
            'event_ticker': m.get('event_ticker', ''),
            'title': m.get('title', ''),
            'subtitle': m.get('subtitle', ''),
            'yes_bid': yes_bid,
            'yes_ask': yes_ask,
            'last_price': last_price,
            'previous_price': prev_price,
            'price_change': price_change,
            'spread': spread,
            'volume': volume,
            'volume_24h': volume_24h,
            'open_interest': open_interest,
            'status': m.get('status', ''),
            'category': m.get('category', ''),
            'close_time': m.get('close_time', ''),
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

    cursor = data.get('cursor', '')
    if not cursor:
        break
    time.sleep(0.1)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('volume_24h', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
